summary: Phase 0 POC validation complete. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering /api/docs, /api/health, send-invite-email (success + 422), and generate-collage across all 6 templates including negative cases (2 photos -> 400, 6 photos -> 400, invalid template -> 422), plus 1080x1920 PNG dimension verification and /api/static/collages/*.png reachability. Frontend: /poc-test loads, all data-testids present, email prefilled correctly, invite email sent successfully (message-id shown), collage generation with 3 real Unsplash JPEGs + moodboard template returned vibe=adventure with caption, quote, 3 dominant color chips, template_used=moodboard, base64 image + open link all rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: the unused `Optional`, `uuid`, `JSONResponse` imports and a stray `import base64/io` in top of server.py are fine but could be trimmed.
collage_service.py `_tpl_filmstrip` has dead code (`for row in range(n + 2): y = ... if False else ...`) — harmless but should be cleaned up.
collage_service.py: `_fit_cover` uses Image.LANCZOS which is deprecated in Pillow 10+ (use Image.Resampling.LANCZOS). Currently works via alias but worth updating.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI `@app.on_event('shutdown')` — consider migrating to lifespan handlers.
MongoDB is initialized but never used in POC — either wire it in or remove the client to avoid a stale connection.
seed_data_creation: Downloaded 5 real Unsplash JPEG photos to /tmp/test_photo_{1..5}.jpg for collage tests. Sent one real invite email to sayanbhatt2005@gmail.com with subject 'You're invited: TEST_ Wanderly POC Verification ✈️'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and expect /tmp/test_photo_1..5.jpg (real Unsplash JPEGs). Re-download with the Unsplash URLs used in this iteration if the temp dir is wiped. Full run takes ~60s because each of 6 templates makes a Gemini vision call. The whole POC is functionally green.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional issues found. All 13 backend tests passed and the frontend flow works end-to-end.
